title: 2010 AMC 8 Problem 1
statement: At Euclid Middle School the mathematics teachers are Miss Germain, Mr. Newton, and Mrs. Young. There are \(11\) students in Miss Germain’s class, \(8\) students in Mr. Newton’s class, and \(9\) students in Mrs. Young’s class taking the AMC \(8\) Contest this year. How many mathematics students at Euclid Middle School are taking the contest?

solutions.text:
There are \(11+8+9 = 28\) students.

Therefore, the answer is C .
hints: No class overlap is described, so the total is a direct sum.
